## The claim

At least one published case report matches five or more of the child seven proband HPO terms and names a gene that step 4 ranks in its top 20.

**Prediction if true.** In the script-derived anchor table, at least one PMID is returned by five or more of the seven per-term PubTator queries for a single step-4 top-20 gene.

**What would refute it.** No PMID reaches five matched terms for any top-20 gene. The literature then corroborates no lead at case-report level, and step 6 records the knowledge route as silent rather than negative.
